binding.request_0: a -> b; terminal notice returns to a
binding.request_1_and_2: b -> a; terminal notices share b FIFO
binding.capacity: excluded; local callback execution is not physical VMM occupancy
binding.initial_environment: Two seeded agents/mandates/current SQL placements; real accounts/tokens and encrypted Transit. Private-schema attempt_limit default is 2.
binding.time: Model deadlines and lease expiration age the corresponding SQL timestamps; production guards and commits still execute.
binding.complete: Real local SQLite writer commits, production request ACK then authenticated VM-bound encrypted reply transaction.
binding.observe: Authenticated production owner Request lookup returns terminal state and, for success, decrypted private result. Observation flag records a successful read, not a new persisted Go state.
binding.recycle: Only model-slot binding is released. Old request UUIDs, results, notification reception and SQLite effects must remain; next arrival allocates a fresh UUID.
binding.notification_failure: Actual TCP ECONNREFUSED after SQL dispatch authorization; lease expiry permits retry. Final retirement uses production event fence and rejects delayed copies.
binding.store_availability: Stop/drain real local mTLS server and close SQLite; actual Health/Fence failures mark it unavailable. Recovery reopens the same current SQLite file with authenticated local transport. This is not rollback restore or a VMM reboot.
binding.authority_availability: The production owner lookup has its own real PostgreSQL pool through a loopback proxy. Closing listener and active connections causes actual lookup failure; reopening the endpoint restores lookup of the same encrypted outcome. This is read-path SQL authority availability, not D5 independent key-root recovery.
binding.worker_availability: A dedicated Go subprocess executes DiscoverWork, ClaimWork, ClaimDelivery, AuthorizeDispatch, encrypted resolution, delivery ACK/CompleteWork and private reply transactions. SIGKILL is observed after request acceptance/discovery; a fresh process consumes the retained ticket. mTLS/SQLite callback driving remains in the parent. This is not the full Firecracker worker service.

remaining_case_requirements.delete-running-agent-preserves-other-wor: Explicit binding for affected participant sets and physical cancellation; simple reciprocal two-agent binding is insufficient
remaining_case_requirements.fence-waits-for-current-execution: Production admission/capacity adapter with competing request
remaining_case_requirements.cannot-recycle-with-outstanding-notice: Production identity retention/cleanup contract; do not invent an application recycle method
remaining_case_requirements.fifo-admission-cannot-overtake: Global runtime/work admission correspondence, not per-agent mailbox FIFO alone
